name: general-skills
description: Domain-agnostic, general-purpose skills — reusable across any project, tied to no single domain. research-survey (systematic investigation & optimization: bisect, ablation, hill-climb, adversarial probe, sweep, root-cause), viz-2x2 (build and critique a 2x2 matrix — axis independence, quadrant balance, placement), and tool-stress (stress-test a tool / MCP interface for an agent). Skills only — no commands, agents, or MCP. Self-contained.
